data.description: Turns a ComfyUI server and its API-format workflows into native agent tools: a bounded ComfyUI HTTP client and API-workflow inspection, a persisted comfyui Settings section with typed per-workflow tools and exact node-input bindings, model-assisted parameter authoring on tier:balanced, one native capability per enabled workflow tool whose descriptor and model-facing schema are generated from Settings and executed in process by the Rust host under the existing frozen broker, approval and evidence paths, two read-only authoring helpers (the node-type catalog and a configured workflow graph) registered as built-ins, and reachability probing plus opt-in local server start. No bridge subprocess, MCP server or host interpreter is involved in running a workflow.
data.name: ComfyUI Workflow Tools and Settings
